prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A solitary figure is suspended mid-air in a dramatic, unnatural backbend, as if levitating above a patch of disturbed earth in a misty, open field at dusk. The subject is a young man dressed in vintage-style clothing: a white button-up shirt, tan trousers, dark boots, and a dark vest, evoking a timeless, slightly old-fashioned look. His arms are limp and his head is thrown back, emphasizing the surreal, almost supernatural quality of the scene. The field is lush with tall, dewy grass, and a faint layer of mist hovers near the ground, adding an ethereal atmosphere. In the background, a dense line of dark trees frames the horizon under a deepening blue sky, with the last traces of daylight fading. The color palette is muted and moody, dominated by cool blues, greens, and earthy browns, with soft, natural lighting that enhances the mysterious, cinematic mood. The composition is wide and centered, with the figure isolated in the frame, creating a sense of stillness and suspense. The overall style is reminiscent of a psychological thriller or supernatural drama, with a painterly quality and a shallow depth of field that keeps the focus on the levitating figure while the background softly recedes into darkness.
